The Trust does not engage in any activities designed to obtain a profit from, or to ameliorate losses caused by, changes in the price of silver.

news.paragraph: Silver prices are facing pressure due to weakening demand, as indicated by recent reports. While some silver-related stocks have seen significant year-to-date gains, the broader outlook for silver itself appears challenged. The ETF SLV, despite a strong past year, is subject to fees and tax rates that may impact net returns.
